sections.title: SERVER GUIDE
sections.body:
Everything you need to find your way around ROC.

If you've just verified, read <#1542514728297959457> first, grab your roles in <#1542515113347649606>, then say hello in <#1540826188094644438>.

For what ROC actually is, see <#1542215038985576539>. For who runs it, see <#1542215043033342024>.

fields.name: Command
fields.value:
**First in Command** runs ROC.
**Second in Command** deputises and can run everything Command can.
**Command** is the wider leadership group.
Unit leaders run their own unit: **Ground Unit Leader**, **Sniper Unit Leader**.

fields.name: Units
fields.value:
**Ground Unit** is the main assault force.
**Sniper Unit** is overwatch and recon.
You pick one during verification. Change it any time in <#1542515113347649606>.

fields.name: Membership
fields.value:
**Unverified** is where you land on join. You can only see the Arrival channels.
**Operator** is the real member role. Verification grants it and opens the server.

fields.name: Support
fields.value:
**Primary Pilot** and **Reserve Pilot** fly transport and air support.
**Medic** patches people up in the field.
Ask a unit leader if you want one of these.

sections.title: OPERATIONS
sections.body:
Ops are posted in <#1542215046820663346> with the time shown in your own timezone, so there's nothing to convert.

Each post has three buttons. Press **Attending**, **Maybe** or **Can't make it**. You can change your answer any time before the op starts. A reminder goes out shortly before kickoff.

After the op, whoever ran it records who actually turned up. Saying you're coming and not showing counts as a no-show, and it's visible on your `/profile`. Press **Can't make it** instead, nobody minds.

fields.name: Yours
fields.value:
`/profile` your record: unit, ops attended, no-shows, warnings, rating
`/roblox` link or update your Roblox username
`/continent` change where you're playing from
`/op list` what's coming up
`/op join` and `/op leave` RSVP without touching the buttons
`/op roster` who's signed up for an op

fields.name: Where
fields.value: Use them in <#1542531684023406674>. Most replies are only visible to you.
